title: Quarter totals with SUM
objective: Total a column with SUM and reuse the same formula pattern for the next column (relative references).
instructions: In B5, total North's sales for January to March. Then total South's sales in C5 with the same pattern, shifted one column.
hints: A formula starts with =. SUM adds every number in a range.
A range uses a colon: B2:B4 means B2 through B4.
Relative references shift with the formula: if B5 refers to B2, the same pattern in C5 refers to C2.
